sourceDocument.title: Metodologia de calcul al performantei energetice a cladirilor, Mc001/1-2-3/2006

coverageMethod.description: Every MC001/6-2013 climate station resolves to one source row from Mc001/1-2-3/2006 Annex A.9.6. Direct source rows are preferred; otherwise the geographically nearest A.9.6 source station is selected by precomputed great-circle distance. Hsol values themselves are never interpolated.
